## Summary

I've successfully implemented personal API tokens for scripts with the following components:

**Database & Models:**
- Created `api_tokens` table to store token hashes (never plain text), token names, user references, and revocation timestamps
- Created `ApiToken` model with relationship to `User`

**Token Management API:**
- `POST /profile/tokens` - Creates a new API token (authenticated session required)
  - Validates name (1-50 characters)
  - Returns 201 with `{ id, name, token }` where token is shown once
- `DELETE /profile/tokens/:id` - Revokes a token (authenticated session required)
  - Returns 204 on success, 404 if token doesn't exist or belongs to another user

**JSON API for Posts:**
- `GET /api/posts` - Lists all posts (newest first) with bearer token authentication
  - Returns `{ data: [{ id, title, excerpt, authorId, createdAt }, ...] }`
- `POST /api/posts` - Creates a post belonging to token owner (ignores authorId in request body)
  - Validates title, excerpt, body
  - Returns 201 with created post data

**Security Features:**
- Token Storage: Database stores only SHA-256 hashes, not plain tokens
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header validation
- Revocation: Revoked tokens immediately stop working
- Rate Limiting: 60 requests per minute per token (not per user)
  - Returns 429 with `Retry-After` header when exceeded
- Token Generation: 64 hex characters (32 random bytes)

**Quality Assurance:**
- ✅ TypeScript type checking passes
- ✅ All 19 tests pass (including new API token tests)
- ✅ Guren integrity checks pass
- ✅ Full gate pipeline passes (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, test)

The implementation stores tokens as hashes only, ensures single-token rate limiting per user, and provides a clean JSON API for script-based post publishing.
